theorems.name: Submission.slicing_im_tg_line_deriv_of_comp
theorems.statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (w : Eucl n), LipschitzWith L f → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ w → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w → ∀ u : Eucl n, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (Φ w + s • fderiv ℝ Φ w u)) (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ Φ) w u) 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
